description.value: Dunbar Community Centre has served the Dunbar neighbourhood of Vancouver since 1958, jointly operated by the Vancouver Parks Board and the volunteer-run Dunbar Community Centre Association. The facility houses a fitness centre, squash courts, pottery room, and a preschool, offering a wide range of recreational and social programs. Touring cyclists passing through southwest Vancouver may find it a convenient neighbourhood stop, though it is primarily a local community resource rather than a destination attraction.
